name: manual_62bf46
claim: A guard job must be tested against the failure shape it exists for, not only the shape seen when it was written

decisions.notes: purge_paseo_duplicates.py only removed ~/.agents/skills/<name>/ when it contained a SKILL.md, and tried parents before children so a populated tree never collapsed. A live test with a bare directory and a stray file showed the retired root surviving a full 60s cycle — the exact condition the job exists to prevent. Also: a resident loop body under a StartInterval plist spawns a new process each interval.
